sourceNote: v2 OFFICIAL: rates transcribed from WotC's 'Collecting Foundations' article. R/M slot: rare 78% / mythic 12.8% / borderless rare 7.7% / borderless mythic 1.5%. The non-foil wildcard slot adds rare 16.3% / mythic 2.6% / borderless 1.9% as expected counts. Special Guests (the 10-card SPG batch released with Foundations) replace a common in 1.5% of Play Boosters, modelled at non-foil prices. Unmodelled, all understating EV: the wildcard's borderless commons/uncommons (~4.2%, near-bulk) and every foil. Uniform-within-tier per pool as everywhere. Pool rule: special tiers contain ONLY prints that exist non-foil, priced non-foil; Collector-exclusive foil-only variants stay display-only.
